description:
Our NFTs on OpenSea, key pros|skins|copies. what: all · market · facts
    · mine · buy · cancel (ref=order hash) · sell (ref=item id, price ETH) ·

    /api/collections/{key}/list. Gates skins from our chain index: skins ·
    skin (ref=catalog) · item (ref=token) · value (wallet) · shop_buy
    (ref=catalog, wallet). Holds no key.
